name: comma2k19
summary: comma.ai 发布的真实高速通勤驾驶数据集，包含道路前视视频、GPS/GNSS、IMU、CAN 总线、车辆速度、转向角和全局相机位姿，适合研究低成本传感器下的驾驶状态估计与时序地图构建。
summaryEn: A real highway commute driving dataset from comma.ai with road-facing video, GPS/GNSS, IMU, CAN bus data, vehicle speed, steering angle, and global camera poses.
scale: 2,019 one-minute highway segments totaling over 33 hours and about 100 GB
scaleZh: 2,019 个 1 分钟高速驾驶片段，总计 33 小时以上，约 100 GB
license: MIT license for the repository; verify dataset redistribution conditions
licenseZh: 代码仓库为 MIT 许可；数据再分发条件需进一步核查
access: Public GitHub repository with dataset download instructions and examples
accessZh: 公开 GitHub 仓库提供数据下载说明和示例片段
verdict: 低成本车载传感器的真实时序驾驶日志
verdictEn: Real sequential driving logs from commodity vehicle sensors
wmNote: 视频、CAN、GNSS/IMU 和相机位姿形成了可对齐的时空状态序列，适合地图、定位和驾驶状态演化建模；任务覆盖较集中在高速通勤场景。
wmNoteEn: Aligned video, CAN, GNSS/IMU, and camera-pose streams support mapping, localization, and driving-state evolution modeling, with a scenario focus on highway commuting.
